name: Calendar Girl
source:
Hero has a tedious personality, but once he says to himself "I want to have a girlfriend by summer vacations". He has sympathies for three nice girls around him...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公性格有些乏味，却突然对自己说：“暑假前我想交个女朋友。”他对身边3名不错的女孩抱有好感……
